# glad (vendored)

OpenGL 3.3 core loader generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad)
with `--api 'gl:core=3.3' --extensions ''` (no extensions), so the app gets
its GL entry points through `glfwGetProcAddress` on every platform — Windows'
opengl32 stops at GL 1.1, and NanoVG's GL3 backend needs the rest.

Regenerate with: `python -m glad --api 'gl:core=3.3' --extensions '' --out-path . c`

Licence: the generated code is `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0` (see the
header of `include/glad/gl.h`); `KHR/khrplatform.h` is Khronos, MIT-style.
